en: The front of the postcard features a sepia-toned image of an ornate pavilion with many people gathered around, dressed in late 19th-century fashion. In the background, a church with a tall steeple and buildings typical of European spa towns can be seen. The words 'Gruss aus Pyrmont' are printed in red at the top right, and 'Stahlbrunnenhalle' is labeled at the bottom left. The back of the card has the German words 'Deutsche Reichspost Postkarte', a museum stamp, and a handwritten note estimating the year as around 1896.
